title: performed by Fin AI Agent
style: Pop rock with elements of musical theater and power pop. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted eighth notes in the verses and open power chords in the choruses. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with staccato riffs. The bass guitar follows the kick drum patterns with a bright, overdriven tone. Drums feature a prominent snare with a short decay and a punchy kick. Synthesizer pads and bright brass-like synth stabs accentuate the transitions. Male vocals are delivered with a theatrical, belt-style technique, featuring frequent harmony stacks in the chorus. The tempo is 145 BPM in the key of G Major.
